title: pctr golden matrix: add SWIEPH frame-chain + sidereal coverage, fix vacuous pass
description:
From swisseph-rs/90 review (vidhi-review, codex+Opus). The pctr golden matrix pins all EQUATORIAL/XYZ/J2000 flag combos to SEFLG_MOSEPH, which calc_pctr rejects (BARYCTR unsupported) → 72 error cases. The only numeric-success combo is SWIEPH|SPEED (ecliptic-of-date). So extract_output's EQUATORIAL/XYZ/J2000 branches and §8's J2000-precession-skip are never compared against C. Additionally tests/golden/pctr.rs:81 silently `continue`s SWIEPH cases when ../swisseph/ephe is absent, and nothing asserts ok_count>0, so the whole test passes vacuously without the fixture — inconsistent with calc_sweph.rs which builds the Swiss eph unconditionally.

Also: C's swe_calc_pctr supports SEFLG_SIDEREAL (sweph.c:8217-8243, same three sub-algorithms via apply_sidereal); the Rust calc_pctr:717 apply_sidereal call is legit and pctr_pipeline returns a real x2000, but no golden case exercises it (tropical-only matrix).

Fix:
- gen_pctr.c: add SWIEPH success cases across all output flags — EQUATORIAL, XYZ, EQUATORIAL|XYZ, J2000, J2000|EQUATORIAL, TRUEPOS, NOABERR, NOGDEFL — plus SIDEREAL (traditional + at least one rigorous ECL_T0/SSY_PLANE projection via swe_set_sid_mode).
- pctr.rs: build Swiss eph unconditionally (match calc_sweph convention); assert ok_count == expected success count (>0) so error-regressions and vacuous passes both fail.
- Configure the Rust sidereal mode to match the C generator's swe_set_sid_mode.
root_cause:
The pctr golden matrix assigned all EQUATORIAL/XYZ/J2000 output flags to SEFLG_MOSEPH, which calc_pctr rejects (BARYCTR unsupported) — so those 3 of 4 frame-chain output paths were never numerically compared against C. The test also silently skipped SWIEPH cases when the ephe fixture was absent with no ok_count>0 guard, letting it pass vacuously. Coverage gap, not a logic error in the ported math.</root_cause>
<parameter name="execution_record">Expanding the matrix to actually exercise the J2000 output path immediately surfaced a genuine bug (fixed in the same commit, see swisseph-rs/99 note and commit body): calc_pctr passed obliquity-of-date to the §9 ecliptic rotation even for SEFLG_J2000, where it must use obliquity(J2000)/oec2000 — a 1.24e-5° longitude error. Fixed by selecting obliquity(J2000) in the J2000 branch, mirroring calc::precess_and_ephem. Also added SWIEPH|SIDEREAL coverage (Lahiri/ECL_T0/SSY_PLANE/USER-ECL_T0) since C supports sidereal pctr (sweph.c:8217) and apply_sidereal was untested; pctr_pipeline returns a real x2000 so the rigorous projections work. Matrix now 196 cases (178 success, 18 error); Swiss eph built unconditionally like calc_sweph. Full suite + clippy green (2 pre-existing complex-type warnings on pctr_bary_state, not new).
